value.rationale: The sharp ratio is the optimal uniform a posteriori constant for a published gap-based adaptive quadrature scheme under exactly its six-derivative-sign assumption, not an arbitrary slice. Its unique minimax linear blend retains all positivity and degree-five exactness while tightening the established error constant from 1/4 to c_*/2 (~11.85%) at precisely the same 7 function evaluations per cell. It resolves a natural quantitative sharpness question. No general runtime advantage or unknown-sign case is claimed.
